# AndroidX FAB references

Eleven unchanged Apache-2.0 originals are pinned with raw URLs and SHA-256 in
`sources.json` at revision `a095da93f8e98dea8748ceed79ea8427aade245f`.
The full FAB composable is already retained in `../ripple/FloatingActionButton.kt`.

`expansion-oracle.json` is independent JVM output generated by
`tools/androidx-fab/snapshot.mjs`: 96 histories and 2,112 sampled frames.
The generator README documents source execution and explicit host/platform
boundaries. Normal unit/browser tests read this file without JVM dependencies.
Tokens establish ordinary 40/56/80/96 and extended 56/56/80/96 heights. The
FAB source and its samples override the large icon token with 36dp and the
medium/large extended gaps with 12/16dp.
